themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents capable of performing complex research tasks autonomously, from data analysis to scientific inquiry.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that help developers write, review, and debug code, improving efficiency and quality.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles comparing different AI tools and platforms for research purposes, highlighting their features, strengths, and weaknesses.

themes.name: AI summarization insights
themes.description: Explores AI's ability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries, providing key insights.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Details platforms specifically designed to facilitate and enhance various aspects of the research process using AI.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Covers AI applications that directly support or integrate with design processes, including idea generation and asset creation.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Examines the impact and application of AI in the recruitment and hiring process, including bias and job market analysis.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Focuses on AI-generated user personas or data used for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates the use, impact, and ethical considerations of AI chatbots in various research contexts, particularly mental health.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Covers the use of AI to analyze datasets, identify patterns, and derive actionable insights.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
